subject: AI & Agents
title: The EU AI Act: A Global First
description: A micro-lesson that makes The EU AI Act: A Global First usable.

hook.text: In 2024, the EU passed the world's first comprehensive AI law. It classifies AI by risk level.

buildup.text: The AI Act bans some uses outright — social scoring, real-time mass surveillance by police.

discovery.text: High-risk systems like hiring tools and medical devices must meet strict transparency requirements.

twist.text: Critics say it stifles innovation. Supporters say it protects fundamental rights.

climax.text: Other countries are using it as a template — the 'Brussels Effect' shapes global AI regulation.

punchline.text: Europe regulated first. The world is watching.

quiz.question: What does the EU AI Act do?
options: Classifies AI by risk level and regulates accordingly
Bans all artificial intelligence in Europe
Requires all AI to be open source

details.summary: The EU AI Act is the world's first comprehensive AI regulation. It classifies AI systems by risk level and imposes requirements ranging from transparency to outright bans on the most dangerous applications.
details.whyItMatters: The EU AI Act sets a global precedent. Its risk-based approach influences how other jurisdictions regulate AI and how companies worldwide design their products.
takeaways: The EU AI Act classifies AI systems into four risk tiers
High-risk systems face strict transparency and audit requirements
The Act bans certain AI uses like social scoring by governments

faq.question: What does the EU AI Act ban?
faq.answer: It bans social scoring by governments, real-time biometric surveillance in public spaces (with exceptions), manipulative AI exploiting vulnerabilities, and untargeted facial recognition database scraping.

faq.question: How does the EU AI Act affect companies outside Europe?
faq.answer: Any company offering AI products or services in the EU must comply, regardless of where they are based. This creates a Brussels Effect where global companies adopt EU standards everywhere.
